Step 5b is complete to the limit of this dispatch's authority. Here is the state, honestly reported.

## Work performed

**Cross-batch edges (the core obligation).** All 926 listed edges (923 distinct pairs, 277 citing items, 164 targets) were read: the citing use in its section/line context against the target's current Statement/Definition, including a second pass over the 63 edges whose target is a declared prerequisite used implicitly (no body wikilink). Result: **923 `accurate`**, no repairs or strikes. Every verdict row carries current `from_sha256`/`to_sha256`; two first-draft notes were corrected before assembly.

**Forward references.** All 15 are orientation-only `Remarks` pointers to items on later example pages. `fwdcheck` requires such links to be declared; the 5b check requires the declaration closed, and re-ordering pages is owner-only — so each declaration was removed and the pointer kept as an **ID mention**, with a "Reading order" note added to the item. This is the same resolution `phase-2-next-21` used. 15 `lemmas-added` verdicts + 15 closed `p2r27-5b-fwd-*` ledger rows; `fwdcheck` and `cross-group-edges check` are green (0 errors over 964 verdict rows: 923 edges, 15 forwards, 10 item changes, 16 gate outcomes).

**Impact windows (both closed).**
- `pre-author → post-5a`: 4,100 changed interfaces / 17,750 affected. Verified decomposition: 1,032 run-authored additions; 3,067 items whose surface text is *identical modulo whitespace* to the pre-author blob (owner reflow commit `87ee9eb6c`); 1 item that also relocated its `Source notes` into the frontmatter locator. 17,684 `still-licensed`, 66 `not-load-bearing`; each note names the supplier, channel and clause status. 0 errors.
- `post-5a → current`: 10 changed interfaces / 132 affected, all from the forward closures; 130 `still-licensed`, 2 `not-load-bearing`. 0 errors.

**Ledgers and bookkeeping.** 31 `5b-cross` defect rows (15 forward closures, 16 gate-recorded); 4 missing frontier-dependency reviews supplied (2 item, 2 page) and `refresh --require-reviewed` passes; 1 stale coverage `alternative` deps list corrected; no published item edited and no published-consumer-ledger row added (no published defect found). Report `research/phase-2-remaining-27-alpha-5b.md` and decisions `…-alpha-5b-decisions.json` written.

## Remaining blockers — owner decision required (gate still red, closure not claimed)

`tools/audit-manifest.mjs` reports **16 defects (exit 1)**, both classes outside 5b repair authority:

- **B1** — three run-authored example items (`ex-classical-root-systems-in-euclidean-coordinates`, `ex-diagonal-cartan-subalgebra-and-roots-of-sl-n`, `ex-weyl-groups-of-b-n-and-d-n-as-signed-permutation-groups`) are homed on **no page** (absent from `plan-spec.json`, all manifests and library pages) after the b-leaf MOVE was half-applied, leaving **13 consumer dependencies** in batches 11/13 unresolvable. Fixing it is a page/reading-order change.
- **B2** — three batch-4 remarks use `external_refs` to draft, session-origin `proved_here:false` catalogue remarks (`rem-nagata-theorem-cp`, `rem-dugundji-extension-linear`, `rem-gerlits-nagy`) that exist on disk but are neither published nor in-run, so the gate cannot resolve them.

Both are recorded as `confirmed_nonfatal` gate verdicts bound to open defect rows and detailed with exact IDs, evidence and the attempted closure in §7 of the report; the remaining Step-5 battery (precheck, depcheck, fwdcheck, rendercheck, prosecheck, depsource, pathcheck, splice-verify, manifest-integrity, content-policy, extcheck, validate-plan, routing final, coverages, url-sweep, contract gates, gate-liveness, defect-ledger validate) is green.
